# T-0898 — Test runs write generated files into portal/bff/data/artifacts and one report is tracked in git

## Report

bff tests and the dev server write drift, schedule and standards output under `portal/bff/data/artifacts/`. One assessment report (`schedules/sch-1/…/Assessment_20261002_164629/`) is already tracked in git, and untracked output blocks merges that touch the same paths. Point test runs at a temp directory, add the path to `.gitignore`, and `git rm --cached` the tracked report.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The behaviour described in the report is fixed.
- [ ] A test covers it and fails without the fix.
- [ ] No file outside `scope` is modified.

## Resolution

`portal/bff/data/` is now gitignored and the one tracked assessment report was untracked, so test and dev-server output can no longer dirty the tree or block merges. Not done: redirecting the bff tests to a temp directory. Nine test files build their own config objects with the default storage path, so an env-var redirect does not reach them; that is a per-file change for later.
